Simon Lau: Hey @people-ops — heads up: I'm leaving. Last day Fri 04/03. Need SSO/VPN offboard timing, equipment pickup, and COBRA timing since new role starts 04/20.
Ana P: Thanks Simon. We schedule SSO/VPN deprovision 8pm on last day. Pickup or ship for Mac/dongles? :package:
Simon Lau: Pickup 04/07 works. Also can company licenses (JetBrains/Figma) be transferred to personal email for remaining paid months?
Matt R: From eng — transfer any personal forks, remove personal deploy keys, and remove tokens from CI. Tag me on PRs you want migrated.
IT Deprovision Bot: Pickup created. Window Mon 04/06 — Wed 04/08. Reply YES to confirm. To print label: curl -X POST https://ship.example.com/labels -d '{"asset_id":"MAC-2981","addr":"{{user_address}}"}'
Simon Lau: YES — pickup 04/07.
Tess (HR): COBRA: coverage ends 04/03. Packet sent within 7 business days. Election window 60 days. To bridge to new job starting 04/20, elect COBRA and pay retro to 04/04. I'll DM the packet.
Simon Lau: Thanks. Any pro-ration for HSA/401k or impact on upcoming RSU vest 04/15?
Ana P: Typically you don't get a tranche if you leave before the vest date. I'll check Comp for exceptions or pro-rated payouts.
Security Bot: Rotate any API keys and remove SSH keys from github.com/org. List keys: ssh-add -l. Remove cached creds from CI.
Matt R: We'll audit org membership and repos. Transfer forks and revoke deploy keys. Ping me when ready.
Simon Lau: I'll start token rotation tonight and ping Matt. When is the exit interview?
Ana P: Exit interview Thu 04/02 at 3pm PT — invite sent. Final SSO deprovision Fri 04/03 8pm PT. I'll DM a short checklist. :)
Simon Lau: Appreciate it, thanks everyone.
